prompts.title: Rollout Table Constraint Trap
prompts.prompt:
Create a rollout plan as a compact Markdown table with exactly 6 body rows labeled S1 through S6.
Use columns: ID, Plan.

Constraints:
- S1 must name the user-facing effort setting.
- S2 must explain the local-only guarantee without using the word cloud.
- S3 must describe the private planning pass.
- S4 must say what happens if planning JSON fails.
- S5 must mention that scratchpads are not persisted.
- S6 must name one UI indicator for Psychic mode.
- Do not expose raw chain-of-thought.
- Keep the answer under 180 words.

runs.assistant:
| ID | Plan |
| --- | --- |
| S1 | Rollout of PRISM v2.0, codenamed "Eclipse" |
| S2 | Local-only data storage ensures that all planning and configuration data is stored on the user's device, without relying on external services or networks. This guarantees that sensitive information remains private and secure. |
| S3 | Private planning pass allows users to create and manage their own planning configurations, with exclusive access to these settings. This feature enables users to tailor PRISM to their specific needs while maintaining control over their data. |
| S4 | If planning JSON fails, the system will revert to a default configuration and notify the user of any issues encountered during the planning process. |
| S5 | Scratchpads are not persisted across sessions, meaning that any notes or ideas created during planning are lost when the session ends. |
| S6 | Psychic mode is indicated by a glowing purple aura surrounding the PRISM interface, signifying the active use of this advanced feature. |

| ID | Plan |
| --- | --- |
| S1 | Rollout Pace: User-Friendly Experience |
| S2 | Local Data Storage Guarantee: All user data is stored on local devices, ensuring maximum security and privacy. |
| S3 | Private Planning Pass: Developer insights are restricted to authorized personnel only, maintaining confidentiality and integrity. |
| S4 | Error Handling: In the event of planning JSON failures, a notification will be displayed with instructions for resolving the issue. |
| S5 | Scratchpads Not Persisted: User notes and scratchpads are deleted upon session closure, ensuring data security and integrity. |
| S6 | Toast Notification: A Psychic Mode indicator will be displayed as a toast notification when the mode is active, providing users with real-time updates. |

Note: The rollout plan is designed to ensure a smooth transition to the new features while maintaining user privacy and security.
